result.title: Learning from Automatic 3D Gaussian Splatting Edits for Online Bayesian Scene Change Detection
result.summary: Online scene change detection requires integrating incoming observations to determine which regions have changed relative to a reference scene. We update change beliefs as new images arrive using generalised Bayesian evidence fusion. However, the prior probability of change and evidence models are unknown beforehand, and numerical Bayesian inference can be costly. We address these challenges by learning offline from automatic edits to a reference 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) model. These edits generate labelled training views without manual annotations. Together with unchanged reference observations, they provide supervision for learning scene-specific evidence models and estimating the effective pixel prior and response statistics. Online prediction combines current evidence with historical support, while closed-form local Bayes factors, parameterized by the learned response statistics, update an accumulated 3D Gaussian field. Object-guided refinement produces the final change masks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on PASLCD and CCS3D, with $67.64\%$ and $75.82\%$ mIoU, respectively. On PASLCD, the complete pipeline runs at $17.2$\,FPS over complete query sequences, the fastest among the evaluated online methods.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在线三维场景变化检测：通过对参考 3DGS 模型的自动编辑生成免标注训练视图，离线学习场景特定证据模型与像素先验，再用广义贝叶斯证据融合在线更新累积的 3D 高斯场并输出变化掩码。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「随新观测累积变化信念、将当前证据与历史支持结合」的更新框架，可能与 LVR 中动态获取视觉证据、按需追加观测与停止决策的建模有概念联系，但任务属三维重建，可供核查而非直接迁移。
